_comment: D123. Mara comes out of the clinic once Hale's crew is down, says four sentences,
and names the thing the quest has been circling since Act 3 without ever saying it
out loud: the splinter is a CUTTING. The scan it grew from is still under Cynosure.
That is the hint at a continuation - and it is not a promise this mod cannot keep,
because source/cynosure_graph.json already streams those sectors on a fact.
Why she appears HERE and not at #ac_mara: since D87 this project ships no
spawnMarkerNodeRef on an actor. An actor spawns at the scene node's own
sceneLocation with a zero offset, so anchoring this scene at #ac_clinic_entrance -
a VERIFIED marker, the same one the decision scene uses - puts her in the doorway
with no new position to stand on and measure. 'Emerging from the clinic' is a
consequence of where the scene is anchored, not of any animation.
KNOWN RISK, first thing to check in game: she was already cast once, in
ash_cache_mara.scene, with keepAlive 1 (D105), so an entity carrying the
dynamicEntityUniqueName 'ashcache_mara' may still be standing inside the clinic
when this scene opens. Two outcomes are possible and only a playthrough decides
which: the spawn plan reuses her where she stands (lines play, nobody visible at
the door), or it places her at this scene's location (correct). The SAME record is
used on purpose - it cannot produce two Maras, which is the failure that would
look unfixable. If she does not appear, the fix is one edit: give this scene its
own character record in source/characters.json (same base, same appearance, new
'record' name) so the unique name differs and the spawn is unconditional.
Why TWO entry points, the same idiom as scene_mara.json (D14) and
scene_decision.json: the intimidate route already gets its own agent count by SMS
(sms_mara_fight_cold, D121), so it gets its own version of this too. The cold path
has no choice hub at all - V is given nothing to say, which is the point of it -
and it still delivers Cynosure, because a sequel hook gated behind being polite to
somebody in Act 3 is a sequel hook half the players never hear.
Both paths end on the same ashcache_mara_warned, which is what the quest graph's
guard_aftertalk reads to keep a phase_revision re-walk from replaying the scene.

nodes._comment: Same Tier3_LimitedGameplay framing every conversation in this quest uses - it is the first rung that actually stops movement. emptyHands matters more here than anywhere else: V walks into this scene straight out of a firefight with a gun up, and Mara's whole character is that she will not stand in front of one. Paired with 'tier_off'; the questphase wires this scene's Default INT/RET because of it.

lines.en-us: Three of them. I counted from a supply closet with my phone in my hand, exactly like I said I would.
lines.ua-ua: Троє. Я рахувала їх із комірчини, з телефоном у руці — рівно так, як і обіцяла.

lines.en-us: The clinic's node has already forgotten the last forty minutes. So have the two cameras on the corner. You were never in this building.
lines.ua-ua: Вузол клініки вже забув останні сорок хвилин. І дві камери на розі — теж. Тебе в цій будівлі ніколи не було.

lines.en-us: Before you decide what to do with that case, there's one thing you don't know yet. It's the only part that matters.
lines.ua-ua: Перш ніж вирішиш, що робити з тим кейсом, — є одне, чого ти ще не знаєш. І саме воно єдине має значення.

nodes._comment: Two options, one answer. The choice is not a branch - it is the only place V gets to react to having just killed three people for a box, and the two readings of that (steady, or shaking) both lead to the same sentence from her. A hub that branched here would be a second ending switch twenty seconds before the real one.

options.en-us: Make it fast. My hands are still shaking.
options.ua-ua: Тільки швидко. У мене ще руки трусяться.

lines.en-us: What's in your hand is a cutting. Somebody grew it off a scan, and the scan is still sitting where they took it.
lines.ua-ua: Те, що в тебе в руці, — живець. Хтось виростив його зі скану, і той скан досі лежить там, де його зняли.

lines.en-us: Cynosure. Under the Badlands. Militech dug it, the FIA inherited it, and Hale has been walking in and out of it for years.
lines.ua-ua: Сайносур. Під Пустищем. «Мілітех» його викопав, ФІА успадкувало, а Гейл роками заходить туди й виходить.

lines.en-us: So burn that case if you want. It closes nothing. Whatever you pick tonight, you're picking it about a copy.
lines.ua-ua: Тож спали той кейс, якщо хочеш. Це нічого не закриває. Хай що ти сьогодні обереш — ти обираєш щодо копії.

lines.en-us: I'll be inside, taking myself out of nine years of paperwork. Keep the phone on. One day you'll want the address.
lines.ua-ua: Я буду всередині — витиратиму себе з дев'яти років паперів. Тримай телефон увімкненим. Колись ти попросиш адресу.

nodes._comment: The cold route in full: she comes out, she reports, she gives V the address anyway and then throws them off the step. Four lines, no hub. The information is identical - only her reason for handing it over changes, and on this route the reason is that she wants V pointed at somebody else.

lines.en-us: Three. All down. Counted from a closet, same as I'd have done for someone I liked.
lines.ua-ua: Троє. Усі лежать. Рахувала з комірчини — так само, як зробила б для того, хто мені подобається.

lines.en-us: Node's wiped, cameras looped. That's not a favour. I'm just not going down for your mess.
lines.ua-ua: Вузол витерто, камери зациклено. Це не послуга. Просто я не сяду за твій безлад.

lines.en-us: One last thing, then get off my step. That case is a cutting. What it was cut from is still under Cynosure, and your scan is filed next to it.
lines.ua-ua: Останнє — і забирайся з мого порога. Той кейс — живець. Те, з чого його зрізали, досі під Сайносуром. І твій скан лежить у сусідній теці.

lines.en-us: Burn it, swallow it, sell it. Hale grows another one by spring. Congratulations on your evening.
lines.ua-ua: Спали його, проковтни, продай. Гейл виростить новий до весни. Вітаю з вечором.

nodes._comment: Set on both routes. The graph's guard_aftertalk reads it so a phase_revision bump cannot drag the player back into this conversation, and it is also the save-game record that V has been told where the source is - which is what a continuation would open on.
